newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.173pts to 102.921.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.173pts to 102.921.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.173 points in Thursday's trading to 102.921, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.058 points to 2.422 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.206 points to 99.594, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.452 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 5.660 points to 1,048.798.
